offering_description.value: Supplies critical materials to businesses serving mobility, energy, connectivity and health markets. It produces lithium and bromine materials using operations that include hard-rock and brine lithium resources, a lithium conversion facility and bromine production facilities.

quotes.quote: Albemarle leads the world in transforming essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health.

Including our global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, our U.S. sites help provide a secure supply of essential elements to customers around the world. Throughout the U.S., Albemarle operates world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, a state-of-the-art lithium conversion facility, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities and the U.S.'s only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV.​
